text:
There is more than meets the eye in this photo…

The ring around the central galaxy cluster is evidence of dark matter, the invisible glue holding the universe together. Dark matter doesn’t emit, reflect, or absorb light, but it has gravity like ordinary matter. 🧵 https://t.co/BgN80VoiRZ

media.alt_text: The scene is cloaked in a cool, blue haze, decorated with the warm light of galaxies and stars. Around the center is a jagged ring where the haze appears absent and dark space peeks through. Credit: NASA, ESA, M.J. Jee and H. Ford (Johns Hopkins University)
